purpose: Reference results reproduced from the existing datasets and scripts before candidate model experiments. CGREC is a previously consulted historical external evaluation and must not be used for selection.

biomass.split: sklearn.model_selection.GroupKFold(n_splits=5); fixed data row order; deterministic for this input and sklearn version
limits: Internal grouped OOF only; not external farm validation.
June 2018 lacks height; 234 complete observations from two campaigns.
Only two farms; neighboring points may remain correlated.

duplicateAudit.duplicateRowsPolicy: Collapse rows sharing animal and minute to one row by averaging motion index when labels agree; exclude all rows for a minute when repeated labels conflict. Animal identity remains the CV group.

behavior.split: six-fold grouped out-of-fold evaluation; each fold with one animal from each breed; all rows from each Breed:ID stay in one held-out fold
limits: Within-source held-out animal validation, not external ranch evaluation.
Ranch identity is not provided per row; leave-one-ranch-out is not possible.
RE/RU confusion remains substantial; macro-F1 and class recall govern improvement, not accuracy alone.

adg.historicalHoldoutStatus: previously consulted; not available for candidate selection or a new final-validation claim
limits: CGREC is historical holdout already consulted and cannot select future models.
1994 has n=14, 192 days mean duration, and very low mean observed ADG; investigate cause without tuning against this holdout.
